rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being liable or predisposed to an unwanted result, as in prone to failure.

example.english: This old phone is prone to breaking down.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 jung4 ji6 waai6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a person physically lying face-down in a particular place or position.

example.english: The child is prone on the sofa.
example.traditional: 細路仔趴喺梳化上面瞓覺。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 paa1 hai2 so1 faa2 soeng6 min6 fan3 gaau3
